verse.verse_1: Woe to those who give short measure,
verse.verse_2: who demand of other people full measure for themselves,
verse.verse_3: but when they give by measurement or weight to others, they give them less.
verse.verse_4: Do such people not realize that they will be raised up,
verse.verse_6: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the Universe?
verse.verse_7: Indeed! The record of the wicked is in the Sijjin --
verse.verse_8: and what could make you understand what the Sijjin is? --
verse.verse_10: Woe, on that Day, to those who reject,
verse.verse_11: those who deny the Day of Judgement.
verse.verse_12: No one denies it except for the evil aggressor.
verse.verse_13: When Our revelations are conveyed to him, he says, "Fables of the ancients!"
verse.verse_14: No! Their own deeds have cast a veil over their hearts.
verse.verse_15: Indeed! On that Day a barrier will be set between them and their Lord,
verse.verse_16: then they shall enter the Fire of Hell,
verse.verse_17: and they will be told, "This is what you were wont to belie."
verse.verse_18: But, the record of the righteous is [preserved] in the 'Illiyyin --
verse.verse_19: and what will make you understand what the 'Illiyyin is? --
verse.verse_21: which those angels closest to God will bear witness to.
verse.verse_22: The virtuous will surely be in bliss,
verse.verse_23: seated on couches and gazing around in wonder.
verse.verse_24: You will find in their faces the brightness of bliss.
verse.verse_25: They will be given a drink of pure wine, sealed,
verse.verse_26: its seal will be of musk -- for this let the aspirants aspire --
verse.verse_27: a wine tempered with the waters of Tasnim,
verse.verse_28: a spring at which those drawn close to God will drink.
verse.verse_29: The wicked used to laugh at the believers --
verse.verse_30: when they passed by them, they would wink at one another;
verse.verse_31: and when they returned to their own people, they would speak of them jestingly;
verse.verse_32: and when they saw them, they said [scornfully], "These men have surely gone astray,"
verse.verse_33: though they were not sent to be their keepers --
verse.verse_34: so today those who believe shall [be able to] laugh at those who denied the truth
verse.verse_35: as they sit on couches, gazing around.
verse.verse_36: Have those who deny the truth [not] been paid back for their deeds?
